# Paper B: Beacon Planner Note

## b1_scope
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_beacon; SECTION_KEY=b1_scope]
Paper Beacon Note USES BeaconPlanner. BeaconPlanner TARGETS Study Planning by converting extracted concepts into review actions and lightweight todo lists.

## b2_dataset
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_beacon; SECTION_KEY=b2_dataset]
BeaconPlanner is EVALUATED_ON WorkshopCards. WorkshopCards is a Dataset made of synthetic workshop notes with deadlines, questions, and resource names.

## b3_metric
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_beacon; SECTION_KEY=b3_metric]
BeaconPlanner REPORTS Complete Evidence Recall. This Metric asks whether all required evidence chunks for a cross-document question are returned together.

## b4_concept
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_beacon; SECTION_KEY=b4_concept]
BeaconPlanner USES Evidence Stitching. Evidence Stitching is a Concept for joining task cues from one document with evaluation cues from another.

## b5_compare
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_beacon; SECTION_KEY=b5_compare]
Paper Beacon Note COMPARES_WITH AtlasRetriever. The synthetic comparison says planning quality depends on retrieval coverage from AtlasRetriever.
